title: Refuse a cap that skips an owned skill or an applied_at file
action: Per D3 and D4, the cap door. New module src/verbs/cells/sync_door.rs (register in cells/mod.rs) with `pub(crate) fn sync_refusal(root, cell, touched: &[String]) -> Option<String>` modelled on obligation.rs:160 `regen_obligation_refusal`. Touched set: the union of finish_support.rs:663 `head_commit_numstat` rows (run at the root finish_support.rs:237 `commit_trailer_history_root` resolves — this adds one git call to the plain cap path, named in the plan) and the `--files` list; with no resolvable commit, `--files` alone. Three checks, each refusing with a remedy line: (a) ownership — for every area from knowledge::ownership::load_ownership whose owns.code matches a touched path and whose owns.skills is non-empty, at least one owns.skills path must be touched, else refuse naming the area and its skills; (b) applied_at — for every rule whose home is touched, every applied_at file must be touched, else refuse naming the rule and the untouched files; (c) prediction — the cell's affects_skills (koh-5) must equal the set of touched skills/** paths as a set, else refuse naming the difference. LEGACY CELLS (judge finding on koh-5): a cell with no affects_skills key predates koh-5 — check (c) is skipped for it and a `sync: no prediction on legacy cell` line is appended to trace.deviations so the skip is visible; and add `affects_skills` / `affects_specs` to `UPDATE_FIELDS` at handlers_write.rs:348 (array-shape validated like files) so an old cell can be backfilled with `cells update`. Escape: a new `--sync-ack "<reason>"` flag on cap and finish (handlers_close.rs:79 `struct CapFlags`, :491 `cap_flags_from`) — blank refuses like `--deviation` does; a non-blank ack stores to trace.sync_ack AND appends a `sync-ack: <reason>` line to trace.deviations so knowledge promote mines it. Wire the call inside handlers_close.rs:148 `cap_cell_from_flags` after the existing report validation and before the write. Help text for cells cap, cells finish and cells update in src/generated/registry_payload.json gains the flag / fields and the three refusals; catalog count if the drift test moves. Sync the home spec docs/knowledge/areas/workflow-state/cells-completion-judge-and-archive.md (this is a refusing door, unlike derived-check-hardening E1's warn-only doors — say so, citing D3) and skills/bee-swarming/references/worker-details.md (finish refusals list); then run the regen chain because skills/ is a manifest root. Tests (cite src/verbs/cells/tests.rs:896 `regen_obligation_fires_refuses_and_can_be_acked` as the pattern): owned code touched + skill untouched → refused naming the skill; same with --sync-ack → capped, ack on trace; home touched + applied_at file untouched → refused; prediction mismatch → refused naming the diff; legacy cell without the key → check (c) skipped with the deviation line; update sets affects_skills on an old cell; no resolvable commit → --files alone; blank --sync-ack → refused; a cell touching no owned path → unchanged behavior.
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee cells && PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --test registry_contracts && .bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check

truths: A cap whose touched set hits an area's owns.code but none of its owns.skills is refused, naming the area and skills, unless --sync-ack carries a reason
A cap whose touched set includes a rule home but not every applied_at file is refused naming the untouched files
A cap whose affects_skills differs from the touched skills/** set is refused naming the difference
Existing cap tests stay green; a cell touching no owned path caps exactly as before
